kurz: Moving air or liquid carries heat in much faster than still air or liquid. That is why a fan oven cooks faster and dries more.
bild_im_kopf: Like wind on a cold day: at the same temperature it feels much colder, because the air carries the warmth away.
was_passiert: Still air forms an insulating layer around food. Flowing air or bubbling water tears it away. A fan oven therefore cooks faster and dries surfaces more.
warum_wichtig: A fan oven is ideal for crispness and several trays at once, but less good for bread in the steam phase and for delicate cakes.
faustregeln: With the fan on, set about 20 °C lower than with top and bottom heat (as a guide).
For crispness use the fan, it dries the surface. For bread switch it off at first: the dough needs moist air to rise.
